nodes.name: NavalAI.yaml
nodes.summary: Naval-focused AI strategy configuration prioritizing naval unit production (helis, hinds, subs, destroyers) with heavy airfield and naval yard construction.

nodes.name: NormalAI.yaml
nodes.summary: Balanced all-purpose AI strategy configuration with ground and naval unit production, fortified defense coverage (tesla coils, pillboxes), and large 40-unit squad sizes.

nodes.name: RushAI.yaml
nodes.summary: Aggressive rush AI strategy configuration emphasizing early tank production (1tnk, 3tnk), V2 rocket launchers, and power infrastructure prioritization with 20-unit squads.

nodes.name: TurtleAI.yaml
nodes.summary: Defensive turtle AI strategy configuration balancing ground unit production with heavy power and defensive structures (pillboxes, turrets) and smaller 10-unit squads.
